# zap-automation-plan.yaml — generated by the DAST agent
env:
  contexts:
    - name: "api-target"
      urls:
        - "https://staging.ejemplo.com"
      includePaths:
        - "https://staging.ejemplo.com/api/.*"
      excludePaths:
        - "https://staging.ejemplo.com/api/health"
      authentication:
        method: "json"
        parameters:
          loginPageUrl: "https://staging.ejemplo.com/api/auth/login"
          loginRequestUrl: "https://staging.ejemplo.com/api/auth/login"
          loginRequestBody: '{"email":"{%username%}","password":"{%password%}"}'
        verification:
          method: "response"
          pollUrl: "https://staging.ejemplo.com/api/auth/me"
          pollFrequency: 60
      sessionManagement:
        method: "headers"
        parameters:
          - header: "Authorization"
            value: "Bearer {%token%}"
      users:
        - name: "test-user"
          credentials:
            username: "dast-scanner@ejemplo.com"
            password: "${ZAP_TEST_PASSWORD}"

jobs:
  # Import OpenAPI specification as endpoint map
  - type: openapi
    parameters:
      apiUrl: "https://staging.ejemplo.com/api/openapi.json"
      context: "api-target"

  # Active scan with plugins selected per endpoint
  - type: activeScan
    parameters:
      context: "api-target"
      user: "test-user"
      maxRuleDurationInMins: 2
      maxScanDurationInMins: 30
    policyDefinition:
      defaultStrength: "low"
      defaultThreshold: "medium"
      rules:

        - id: 40018
          strength: "high"
          threshold: "low"
        # XSS Reflected — medium priority
        - id: 40012
          strength: "medium"
          threshold: "medium"
        # Path Traversal — high priority
        - id: 6
          strength: "high"
          threshold: "low"
        # Remote File Inclusion — medium priority
        - id: 7
          strength: "medium"
          threshold: "medium"
        # Server Side Request Forgery — high priority
        - id: 40046
          strength: "high"
          threshold: "low"

  # Export results as JSON for the analysis agent
  - type: report
    parameters:
      template: "traditional-json"
      reportDir: "/zap/results/"
      reportFile: "zap-report.json"
